struct.doc: The mode control sits in a different window of the hub, not in the block above: its offset is the local register base of the public vendor header subtracted from the address the notes record. No shipped kernel reads or writes it, so only the offset is stated. See MIG_CONFIG_LOCAL_OFFSET.
